title.zh: 欧盟将Circle的USDC列为MiCA下首个「重要电子货币代币」
title.en: EU classifies Circle's USDC as first 'significant' e-money token under MiCA

current_state.zh: The European Banking Authority classified Circle's USDC as a 'significant e-money token' under MiCA, placing the $73 billion stablecoin under joint EU and French supervisory oversight with heightened compliance requirements.
current_state.en: The European Banking Authority classified Circle's USDC as a 'significant e-money token' under MiCA, placing the $73 billion stablecoin under joint EU and French supervisory oversight with heightened compliance requirements.

updates.title_zh: USDC被列为欧盟首个「重要电子货币代币」
updates.title_en: USDC被列为欧盟首个「重要电子货币代币」
updates.what_changed_zh: The European Banking Authority designated Circle-issued USDC as the EU's first 'significant' e-money token under MiCA, transferring direct supervision of its capital, reserves, liquidity and recovery/redemption plans to the EBA from France's ACPR starting 12 November 2026, and paired with a new EBA–NYDFS cooperation memorandum.
